terra.problem: The reference to a dusty place alludes to Papa's backstory without identifying it as the junk drawer.
Saying nobody is dropping wrath on the person from outside goes beyond the text and can imply that the wrath does not come from God.
The explanation claims that giving one group more time would be favoritism and that everyone has the same clock. The passage says neither.
Saying the evidence is not passed along from somebody else rules out a connection the passage does not address.
The statement that angels are mighty is a Bible fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
